entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Shido spilled the beans at[n]that conference, right?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Why isn't it making any news?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Is it because he's a politician?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I have no doubt that political[n]connections are involved.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But that theoretically shouldn't[n]have an impact on the news...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What about all the people who saw[n]him on TV? They HAD to see that!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Everyone should've heard him[n]say all that heavy stuff, right?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: What happened can't be kept[n]secret. It'll be apparent soon.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Makoto's sister is[n]working on a case too!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I'm sure we'll see the results of[n]that if we just wait patiently.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Let's assume so. More importantly,[n]we have exams coming up...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I think they may have[n]come at a good time.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: We've really gone through a lot[n]lately. Everyone must be tired.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It certainly was a[n]good deal of trouble...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Uh, exams are more tiring than[n]any shit we've been doing...
